today: Kwena Lodge, villas and a Tented Eco Camp spread across 11,000 ha
The Tented Eco Camp is described as off-grid with no cell reception
An anti-poaching unit and a counter-poaching training camp run on the reserve
context: Gondwana runs a lodge, several villa groups and an off-grid eco camp across 11,000 ha, with its own anti-poaching unit. We propose one backbone that belongs to the reserve and reaches the villas, the camp and the field.
security_note: The Rainbow Rhino Initiative and the anti-poaching unit already use drones and tracking. A reserve-wide backbone carries that data, the gate cameras and after-hours communication on one monitored network.
